[/b][/center]


[line]
[b]
[size=5][color=#8BC34A]📢 THE REBIRTH: WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 2.0.2?[/color][/size]
[i]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6+ | Version 2.0.2[/i]
GreenUpgrades V2 is the ground-up rebuild of the classic multi-level greenhouse expansion mod, completely modernized and thoroughly tested for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Say goodbye to legacy bugs and clunky workarounds! This version delivers a clean Content Patcher architecture combined with an ultra-lightweight SMAPI companion mod to give you maximum farming freedom, seamless automation, and full in-game configuration.
[/b]
[line]
[b]🌟 What's New in Version 2.0.2 (Changelog & Fixes)
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Resolved Chest Relocation Bug: Fixed an issue where chests and barricades placed on stone floors or cellars would unexpectedly get relocated upon loading saves or walking through doors. Objects now stay strictly where you place them![/b][/*]
[*][b]Clutter-Free Greenhouse Interior: The interior nutrient tank chest is now hidden by default to keep your greenhouse completely clean and spacious. You can deposit fertilizer directly from the outside tank on your farm, and crops will still be fertilized and watered automatically every morning.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Full Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Integration: Easily customize all mod features on the fly from the in-game options menu or via
[/b]
[code]config.json[/code][b].[/b][/*]
[*][b]Independent Feature Toggles: You can now enable or disable tree relocation, crop relocation, object rescue, and the interior tank chest separately according to your playstyle.[/b][/*]
[*][b]100% Item Safety via Global Inventory: All deposited fertilizers are securely preserved in Stardew Valley 1.6's persistent global inventory—you will never lose items when toggling settings or upgrading.[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]🌾 Key Features (Available Levels 1 & 2)
★ Level 1 Greenhouse Expansion
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]15x15 Tillable Field (225 Tiles): 100% tillable and tested ground for massive planting.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Integrated Aging Cellar: Expands your farm's artisan capacity with an underground cellar for casks (wine, cheese, mead, etc.).[/b][/*]
[*][b]Carpenter Upgrade: Upgraded at Robin's shop for 60,000g, 200 Wood, 200 Stone, 15 Copper Bars, and 50 Clay (2 days build time).[/b][/*]
[/list][b]★ Level 2 Smart Greenhouse
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]20x20 Tillable Field (400 Tiles): Huge farming space with room for all your favorite crops.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Morning Auto-Watering: Never waste tile space or resources on sprinklers inside the greenhouse again! All tilled soil is automatically watered every morning.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Automated Nutrient Tank:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Deposit your favorite fertilizers directly into the external module on the farm wall.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Smart Fertilizer Application: Automatically dispenses Speed-Gro to growing sprouts to speed up harvests, and Quality Fertilizer to mature crops to maximize produce quality![/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Expanded Underground Cellar: Even more room for aging casks and storage.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Carpenter Upgrade: Upgraded at Robin's shop for 120,000g, 300 Wood, 300 Stone, 20 Copper Bars, 5 Iron Bars, 15 Sprinklers, and 100 Clay (2 days build time).[/b][/*]
[/list][b]★ Free Fruit Tree & Crop Relocation
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pick up, move, and replant living fruit trees and crops inside the greenhouse with a simple click without losing growth progress or killing the plant.[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration (GMCM)
If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, access the in-game settings to customize:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Show Interior Tank Chest [i](Default: OFF)[/i] — Keep the interior completely clean and feed fertilizer from the outside, or turn ON to have a physical emerald chest by the door.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Chest & Object Relocation [i](Default: ON)[/i] — Safely rescues objects trapped inside solid walls only when Robin completes a building upgrade.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Fruit Tree Relocation [i](Default: ON)[/i] — Toggle the ability to pick up and move fruit trees.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Crop Relocation [i](Default: ON)[/i] — Toggle the ability to pick up and move live crops.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]🗺️ Future Updates (Levels 3, 4 & 5)
Levels 3, 4, and 5 are currently in active development and will be released in an upcoming major update once their custom interior maps and designs are fully completed.
[/b]
